claims: "Go Blue!" is the rallying cry for the University of Michigan Wolverines.

The phrase "Go Blue" is believed to have originated in the 1950s.
The phrase "Go Blue" was popularized at University of Michigan hockey games.
Go Blue Guarantee is a financial aid initiative for Michigan residents.
Go Blue Guarantee provides free or reduced tuition for up to four years.
"Those Who Go Blue" is a university-wide campaign.
"Those Who Go Blue" connects students, alumni, and fans.
The Michigan community includes the Ann Arbor, Dearborn, and Flint campuses.
